- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English (default)
The unique ID of the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the client generates a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

title.zh: 获取地址被引用的信息
